figures.label: Patients on the system
figures.counts: Every patient record held, from any date. All are synthetic people.

figures.label: Insurance enrolments
figures.counts: Patients enrolled in a plan on this system, from any date, whether or not a premium has been paid.

figures.label: Outbreaks confirmed
figures.counts: Suggested outbreak alerts a GHS official confirmed this quarter.

figures.label: Patients with a reading
figures.counts: Different patients with at least one reading this quarter, not marked entered-in-error. For a facility: taken by that facility's staff.

figures.label: Readings recorded
figures.counts: Vital-sign and lab readings this quarter, not marked entered-in-error. For a facility: taken by that facility's staff.

figures.label: Appointments booked
figures.counts: Appointments starting this quarter that were not cancelled. For a facility: with that facility's doctors.

figures.label: Referrals
figures.counts: Referrals created this quarter, except cancelled ones. For a facility: sent to it or to one of its staff.

figures.label: Prescriptions dispensed
figures.counts: Prescriptions a pharmacist dispensed this quarter. For a facility: dispensed there.

figures.label: Emergencies raised
figures.counts: Emergency alerts raised this quarter, except cancelled ones. For a facility: raised for it.

figures.label: Diarrhoea cases (synthetic)
figures.counts: Weekly district case counts added up for weeks starting this quarter. Source: synthetic. A count, not a rate.

figures.counts: Weekly district case counts added up for weeks starting this quarter. Source: synthetic. A count, not a rate.
